Title: Core spec alignment for Redcap test case 16.5.1.5, 16.5.1.6, 16.5.2.3, 16.5.3.2.1 and 16.5.3.2.2 Reason for change: In TC 16.5.1.5 and TC 16.5.1.6, when bandwidth is 20MHz, according to TS 38.101-1, PRB number should be 51 not 52. In TC 16.5.2.3, the CCE level for 1 RX redcap UE is 8. But according to TS 38.133 Table 8.5B.2.1-1, for 1 RX redcap UE, CCE level should be 16. In TC 16.5.3.2.1 and TC 16.5.3.2.2, for test configuration 3, SSB SCS is 30KHz, but TRS SCS is 15KHz. SCS configuration doesn’t align. Summary of change: In TC 16.5.1.5 and TC 16.5.1.6, when bandwidth is 20MHz, PRB number is updated to 51. In TC 16.5.2.3, the CCE level for 1 RX redcap UE is updated to 16. In TC 16.5.3.2.1 and TC 16.5.3.2.2, for test configuration 3, TRS configuration 3 is set to TRS.1.2 TDD with SC

[8] (ran5_cr_chunks 38.533, sim=0.4491)
Reason for change: In TC 16.4.1.1 and 16.4.1.2, for config 3: BW 20MHz with 51RBs; SRS config is set to be “SRSconf.1”. It means c-SRS=25, b-SRS=0. According to 38.211 Table 6.4.1.4.3-1, SRS has 104RB. It means SRS RBs exceeds BW RBs. SRS config should be update and make sure SRS is within BW. In TC 16.4.3.1 and 16.4.3.2, for config 3: BW 20MHz with 51RBs; c-SRS=24, b-SRS=0. According to 38.211 Table 6.4.1.4.3-1, SRS has 96RB. It means SRS RBs exceeds BW RBs. SRS config should be update and make sure SRS is within BW. In TC 16.5.3.1.1 and 16.5.3.1.2, there are no test config 5&6, but there are TRS configurations for test config 5&6. They are typor error. Summary of change: Core spec alignment with 38.133: In TC 16.4.1.1, introduce a new table to add SRS configuration. And TC 16.4.1.2 reuse
